name: nexus-coders-brand-audit
description: Multi-skill Agent Skill Marketplace for automated website brand auditing — evaluating off-site AI discoverability (crawlability, entity corroboration, freshness, AI-summary readiness), and on-site visitor engagement (retention, orientation, email-digest content readiness) to produce prioritized, mechanism-sound fixes and proactive improvements.
author: Nexus Coders

skills.description: The designated entrypoint skill that coordinates specialized sub-skills (discoverability-audit, engagement-audit), synthesizes cross-skill correlations, and emits the final unified JSON audit report.

Unified skill for off-site AI discoverability, entity corroboration, and content readiness: robots.txt AI crawler access, XML sitemap, llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, JS-render gaps, non-text media trapping, Wikipedia/Wikidata entity disambiguation, sameAs knowledge-graph links, OpenGraph/hreflang personalization, AI-summary content ratios, and temporal freshness.

Dedicated skill for on-site visitor retention and AI-summary readiness: above-the-fold value proposition clarity, landing orientation, information density, CTA friction, mobile viewport stability, email-digest content readiness, and above-the-fold personalization density.
